content: अदक्षिण {%a.%} [<sab>न˚ त˚</sab>] .²1 Not right, left. .²2 [<sab>न˚ ब˚</sab>] Not bringing in Dakṣiṇā to the priests; without any gifts (as a sacrifice); अदक्षिणास अच्युता दुधुक्षन् <ls>Rv. 10. 61. 10</ls> मृतो यज्ञस्त्वदक्षिणः <ls>Pt. 2. 94</ls>. .²3 Simple, weak-minded, silly; मेनेऽथ सत्यमेवेति परिहासमदक्षिणा <ls>Rām.</ls> .²4 Not handy, skilful or clever; awkward. .²5 Unfavourable <ls>Bhāg. 10. 82. 20</ls>.
